title: Derived Chow neighbourhood with a pseudo-coherent kernel
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and of finite presentation [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and let $x\in X$. There exist an open neighbourhood $U\subseteq X$ of $x$, an integer $n\geq0$, an open $V\subseteq P=\mathbf P^n_A$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist], a finitely presented closed immersion $h:Z\hookrightarrow T=X\times_A P$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-fibre-product], a point $z\in Z$, and $E\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-category], with the following properties. Writing $b:Z\to X$ and $c:Z\to P$ for the projections, $b^{-1}(U)\to U$ is an isomorphism and $b(z)=x$; $c^{-1}(V)\to V$ is a closed immersion; and $b^{-1}(U)=c^{-1}(V)$ contains $z$. Moreover $E|_{X\times_A V}\simeq(h_*\mathcal O_Z)[0]|_{X\times_A V}$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], $E$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and $H^j(E)_t=0$ for every integer $j$ and every $t\in T\setminus h(Z)$.

proof.text: Use [lemma-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system-affine] to write $\operatorname{Spec}A$ as the limit of the spectra of its finitely generated integer subalgebras. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-family-descent] to the singleton family $X$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-descend-separated] to its structure morphism, increasing the stage so it is separated. This gives a finite type $\mathbf Z$-subalgebra $A_0\subseteq A$, a separated finitely presented $X_0/A_0$, and $X\simeq X_0\times_{A_0}A$. All stages are affine (hence qcqs) and the descended source is qcqs, as required by the separatedness descent node. Let $x_0$ be the image of $x$.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, first paragraph, noetherian approximation

proof.text: First construct the data over $A_0$. The scheme $\operatorname{Spec}A_0$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], since it is finite type over $\mathbf Z$; the same node makes $X_0$ Noetherian. Choose an affine open $U_0$ containing $x_0$. By [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation], its coordinate ring is finitely presented over $A_0$, hence finitely generated. Apply [lem-chow-affine-immersion] to obtain $j:U_0\hookrightarrow P_0=\mathbf P^n_{A_0}$. The projection $P_0\to\operatorname{Spec}A_0$ is proper by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper], hence separated and finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism]; the Noetherian node also makes $P_0$ Noetherian. By [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change], $T_0=X_0\times_{A_0}P_0$ is finite type over $X_0$, so is Noetherian by the same Noetherian node.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, second paragraph, affine embedding and final paragraph, Noetherian ambient scheme

proof.text: Let $Z_0$ be the scheme-theoretic image of $(\mathrm{id}_{U_0},j):U_0\to T_0$ [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image]. The open inclusion $U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ is quasi-compact by [lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation]. Apply [lemma-nagata-scheme-image-partial-section], using separatedness of $P_0/A_0$, to obtain $b_0^{-1}(U_0)\simeq U_0$, identified with the original graph. Thus there is exactly one $z_0$ above $x_0$.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, second paragraph, graph closure and first projection

proof.text: Let $Y_0\subseteq P_0$ be the scheme-theoretic image of $j$. The immersion $j$ is the closed immersion $U_0\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^n_{A_0}$ followed by the open immersion $\mathbf A^n_{A_0}\hookrightarrow P_0$ into the Noetherian $P_0$, so it is quasi-compact by [lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation]. By [lemma-nagata-immersion-open-in-scheme-image], it identifies $U_0$ with an open $J_0\subseteq Y_0$. By the minimal property [lemma-nagata-scheme-theoretic-closure-minimal], $Z_0$ lies in the closed subscheme $X_0\times_{A_0}Y_0$ (closed by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]) and is the image there of the same graph: a closed subscheme there is also closed in $T_0$, so the two minimal images coincide. Interchange the two factors and apply [lemma-nagata-scheme-image-partial-section] with open $J_0\subseteq Y_0$ and separated $X_0/A_0$. It gives $c_0^{-1}(J_0)\simeq J_0$, again the original graph. Choose an open $V_0\subseteq P_0$ whose intersection with $Y_0$ is $J_0$; such an open exists by the subspace topology. Then $c_0^{-1}(V_0)=b_0^{-1}(U_0)$ as open subschemes of $Z_0$, since both equal the graph, and $c_0^{-1}(V_0)\to V_0$ is the closed immersion $Y_0\cap V_0\hookrightarrow V_0$.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, third paragraph, second graph closure and choice of V

proof.text: Write $h_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow T_0$. Since $T_0$ is Noetherian, [lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation] (with the open immersion the identity) makes $h_0$ finitely presented; $Z_0$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], as a closed immersion is finite type. Put $E_0=(h_{0,*}\mathcal O_{Z_0})[0]$. The structure sheaf $\mathcal O_{Z_0}$ is quasi-coherent of finite type, hence coherent on the locally Noetherian $Z_0$ by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. By [lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology] its pushforward is coherent. Hence [lem-sc-coherent-pseudo-coherent] makes $E_0$ pseudo-coherent. It is zero on $T_0\setminus h_0(Z_0)$ by the definition of ordinary pushforward. Its restriction to $X_0\times_{A_0}V_0$ is precisely the degree-zero pushforward of the structure sheaf of $W_0=c_0^{-1}(V_0)$.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, final paragraph, coherent closed kernel

proof.text: Pull back $U_0,V_0,Z_0$ to $A$, set $n$ equal to the integer just constructed, and denote the resulting closed immersion by $h:Z\hookrightarrow T=X\times_A P$. Projective spaces commute with base change by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-pullback]. Closed immersions remain closed by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]. Finiteness of presentation also persists: locally the finitely generated ideal $(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ defining $h_0$ pulls back to the ideal generated by the images of those same $f_i$; its closed immersion is affine and thus quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The inverse images of $U_0,V_0$ agree in $Z$ by associativity of fibre products, and the restricted isomorphism and closed immersion pull back to the required ones. In particular $b^{-1}(U)\simeq U$ gives a unique $z$ over the chosen $x$, and this point belongs to $c^{-1}(V)$.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, first paragraph, base change of the geometric data

proof.text: Let $q:T\to T_0$ be the projection and set $E=Lq^*E_0$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Locally represent $E_0$ by a bounded-above finite free complex, as in [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]. It is K-flat by [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat], so its termwise pullback computes the derived pullback and remains bounded-above finite free. Thus $E$ is pseudo-coherent. Restrictions of derived pullback commute with this calculation, or equivalently with derived-pullback composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. The complement $T\setminus h(Z)$ is exactly $q^{-1}(T_0\setminus h_0(Z_0))$ by the inverse-image construction of a closed subscheme. Since $E_0$ is zero on the latter open, $E$ is zero on the former; in particular every $H^j(E)_t$ there is zero.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, first paragraph, pseudo-coherence and support under derived pullback

proof.text: It remains to identify $E$ on the whole open $X\times_A V$, not merely on $U\times_A V$. Apply [lem-sfb-relative-flat-closed-kernel-base-change] with $S_0=\operatorname{Spec}A_0$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $Y_0=V_0$, and $i_0:W_0\hookrightarrow X_0\times_{A_0}V_0$. Its two flatness hypotheses hold: $W_0\to X_0$ is the open immersion $U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ (its local ring maps are identities), while $V_0\to\operatorname{Spec}A_0$ is flat because the projective standard charts are polynomial algebras by [lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-standard-charts], and their structural maps are flat by [lem-nagata-polynomial-projection-flat]; their open restrictions are flat on stalks, or by [lem-pc-affine-flat-module-localization-preserves-flatness]. By derived-pullback composition, the left side of the comparison is $E|_{X\times_A V}$; the right side is the degree-zero pushforward of $\mathcal O_{W}$ for $W=Z\cap(X\times_A V)$. Ordinary pushforward restricted to an open is pushforward of the restriction, directly on sections. This is $(h_*\mathcal O_Z)[0]|_{X\times_A V}$ and proves the remaining clause.

source.place: Tag 0CSJ, lemma-derived-chow, first paragraph, Tor-independent square and clause (5)
